payload.title: Machines on Machines as the reference implementation of the standard front end
payload.description:
Planning draft (2026-11-07). Papyrus is promoting MoM's publication layer into core (Papyrus initiative PPY-25ffa3 on its board; closed predecessor PPY-bcfd2d). MoM contributes the design and then removes its own copies. MoM's own experiments stay here until a second consumer (Threat Intelligence) needs them. Stories below depend on the Papyrus stories named in each.
Done when: MoM runs on the core preset and a brand pack, its hooks.py holds only ornaments, and its golden renders are unchanged.
